messages:
sam: quick heads-up — PR #2578 is a tiny API surface cleanup (rename exported consts to be clearer). pushed a draft, looking for one more approval before tonight's merge window. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2578

alex: taking a look now. saw CI red on fmt check in the last run — can you run the formatter and repush? usually `gofmt -w .` and `git add -A && git commit --amend --no-edit` does it.

maria: fwiw let's avoid breaking downstream callers — can we keep the old consts as deprecated aliases for one release? small shim:
```go
// Deprecated: Use NewThingName instead.
const OldThing = NewThingName
```
That buys a release cycle to migrate.

sam: good call, added deprecated aliases and ran gofmt. pushed as `sam/rename-2578`. also added a short comment in the godoc explaining the rename. CI triggered again.

ci-bot: build: gofmt check failed on 1 file (run `gofmt -w` locally). Full logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/4521

sam: weird, I fixed locally — looks like a windows line ending issue on `api/constants.go`. ran `dos2unix` and repushed.

jen: quick note — the rename touched the generated client tests, you updated the fixtures, thanks. I ran the integration suite locally, all green except the `client/retry_test` flake (unrelated IE intermittent).

alex: reviewed the code semantics — lgtm on the rename/alias approach. couple tiny nits in comment phrasing, not blocking. can you rebase onto main to pick up the latest CI config?

sam: rebased onto main and force-pushed. CI is green now. any objections to merging in the next 30m?

alex: approved. please squash the WIP commits and use a concise commit message referencing the PR and deprecations.

maria: approved from compatibility side as long as aliases remain for one minor release.

sam: done — squashed into `rename(api): rename ThingName -> NewThingName (add deprecated aliases)` and merged in the window. thanks everyone :tada:

jen: thanks! noted in the release notes draft to call out the deprecated consts so SDKs can pick it up.

sam: added a line to release notes. moving on.
